doc.title: Marty Sheller interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 9, 2022

title: The horn hesitation at the end of 'Watermelon Man'
summary: How the three horns came up with the hesitation figure.

story.theme_name: Charlie Parker, Dizzy and the bebop revolution
story.community_name: Playing with Count Basie: the band, its feel and its people

blocks.x: I really also, this is pretty minute I guess, but when you get to the last [scats] the horn players, you guys did this wonderful sort of like hesitation [scats].
You almost feel like oh no the dancers are going to fall down. But you know of course one comes back in where it’s supposed to.

Yeah. I’m not sure exactly how that came about but I think the three horn players, which were me, Bobby Capers on alto and Hubert Laws on tenor, just somehow decided hey let’s do that. I think there’s no other explanation I can think of.
